data.body: **[P2] Use the latest operation ancestry when draining.** `info.operations` is captured before `onInvocationEnd`; while `forceFlush()` is awaited, `onOperationChange` can enqueue a completion alongside newer parent/ancestor states. If that update makes an ancestor terminal, this stale snapshot misses the abandoned parent and emits a span referencing a context that will never be exported or replayed. Retain or merge the latest `OperationChangeInfo.operations` and use it here, with a blocked-flush regression test where the ancestor and completion update arrive after invocation end begins.
